priorities.topic: NYC Congestion Pricing Transit Ridership Gains — Spatially Uneven Demand Changes
priorities.angle: New arXiv study finds congestion pricing drove public transit gains but with spatially uneven ridership patterns — which neighborhoods won, which were left behind, and what this means for equity-conscious transit planning elsewhere.
priorities.rationale: Fresh arXiv paper (2026 submission) on NYC's first-in-US congestion pricing program and its transit demand effects. NYC program has been live long enough for real ridership data. Directly bridges our transit equity + congestion pricing coverage without duplicating prior work. Strong hook for the niche audience.

priorities.topic: Simulating Transit Fare Policies in NYC: Socioeconomic-Aware Framework
priorities.angle: A new arXiv paper models how different fare structures (flat, distance-based, income-tiered) affect ridership and equity across NYC neighborhoods. What simulation reveals about who bears the cost of fare policy decisions.
priorities.rationale: Directly complements our existing coverage on fare structure design and low-income riders. New methodology paper with practical transit agency implications. Timely given ongoing federal transit funding debates. Novel framing not previously covered.

priorities.topic: ChatPlanner: How LLMs Are Personalizing Public Transit Routing
priorities.angle: New arXiv paper introduces ChatPlanner, a large language model framework for personalized transit routing — letting riders describe preferences in plain language rather than navigating rigid app interfaces. What this means for transit usability and the transit app dark UX problem.
priorities.rationale: LLM + transit is a high-interest topic in our niche. This paper is recent (2026). Ties into our existing transit app dark UX coverage. Bridges AI and urban mobility without repeating covered topics. Short-medium explainer format fits naturally.

priorities.topic: NYC Congestion Pricing: Before vs. After Transit Ridership by Borough
priorities.angle: Visual companion to Rank 1 article. Bar/map comparison of MTA ridership changes by borough and mode (subway, bus, commuter rail) before and after congestion pricing launch. Highlight the equity gap.
priorities.rationale: Visual explainer for the Rank 1 article — infographics consistently perform well in our niche. No prior congestion pricing infographic exists in our library. Data available from MTA and the arXiv paper.

priorities.topic: Gemini Code Assist Shutdown: What Transit Tech Teams Need to Know Before July 17
priorities.angle: Google is shutting down Gemini Code Assist on July 17 — 12 days away. Transit agencies and transit-tech vendors relying on it face migration decisions now. What tools exist, what the transition looks like, and why this matters for AI adoption in public agencies.
priorities.rationale: Hard deadline 12 days out makes this time-critical. Bridges AI tools + transit tech niche. Practical and actionable for a technically-oriented reader. Not previously covered in depth.
